Measured with llama.cpp · kernels from the capture
Modeled roofline: 33.3 ms per prefill.
○ llama.cpp: 14463.8 tok/s · 141.6 ms per prefill · 108.3 ms above roofline.
  whole prefill of 2048 tokens, measured untraced; 4 forward call(s) of up to 512 tokens (llama-bench
n_ubatch 512, n_batch 2048)

Where the prefill time goes
ms of one 2048-token prefill, worst first; prefill ms if fixed is the 141.6 ms untraced prefill less that
row's lost ms. ms at ceiling is max(operations / the measured peak of the path the kernel's instructions
use, bytes / bandwidth); MFU is operations over that peak for the row's time; no ceiling: the model counts
no work for the kernel, so all of its time is lost. The rows sum to the 139.4 ms the captured prefill took
from its first kernel to its last; the untraced prefill is 141.6 ms. attention: instructions on more than
one path; the ceiling uses the slowest of them.

Prefill audit at 2,048 tokens
Every row of the 2,048-token prefill, worst first by ms lost. The untraced prefill is 141.6 ms [E2]; the
captured rows sum to 139.4 ms [E1]. Rows that each lose under 1% of it are one line.
[E1] prefill_trace.json lengths.2048.rows: the captured prefill, kernel by kernel, attributed
[E2] timing_trace.json rows[context=2048]: the untraced prefill, clock and power
[E3] prefill_trace.json peaks, bandwidth_gbs: the measured peaks (target facts) and bandwidth (measured on
this GPU (native CUDA probe, 2026-10-10))
[E4] kernel_compare/prefill_capture/2048/: the engine's own launches as the vendor profiler read them
